questions.question: The LORD promised to sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah like a field. What would He sow them with?

answers.text: The seed of man and of beast
The seed of wheat and of barley
The seed of vine and of olive

questions.question: The LORD promised Israel a new covenant unlike the one made with their fathers. Which land did He lead them out of then?
In the new covenant the LORD promised Israel through Jeremiah, where would He put His law?

answers.text: In their minds and on their hearts
On the doorposts of their houses

questions.question: The LORD promised that under the new covenant He would still remember His people's sins. True or false?
